title: record:chatter and record:discussion do not pass commentsShown, so a feed that hides comments still offers the composer and the comments-only option
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ① (class a): an out-of-scope finding from the dev report on #34383 (comment 6933253328, PR #34524), passed on by area `o2-A`. Dedupe: `commentsShown chatter discussion`, `record:discussion comment composer types`. The seat runs these before triage.

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#34371(PR #34388)让 `record:activity` 在 `types` 不含 `'comment'` 时不再显示评论框和「仅评论」选项，依据的是一个 `commentsShown` 判定。但 `record:chatter` 和 `record:discussion` 的渲染端没有把 `commentsShown` 传下去。时间线组件默认把它当作 true,所以这两种块在隐藏评论的配置下，仍然显示评论框和「仅评论」。
- 为什么要修:#34383(PR #34524)让编写期拒收这种矛盾配置，但用代码拼装的宿主(不走编写校验)仍然能触达这个分支，用户在这里发出的评论会立刻从视图里消失。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

Make `record:chatter` and `record:discussion` pass `commentsShown` to the timeline exactly as `record:activity` does after #34388, so all three blocks share the one rule.

## Done when

- One renderer test per block pins that a `types` list without `'comment'` shows no composer and no comments-only option.
- An ablation of the prop pass-through turns each test red.
